minutes.headline: Board workshopped parks, turf field and Turkey Hill; earth removal permits discussed with motions to not renew two
minutes.summary: The board heard the town manager's report, including ratification of a three-year municipal employees contract, then reviewed earth removal permits with the building commissioner. A workshop followed on parks and fields, the artificial turf field agreement, and Turkey Hill and town office space. The School Committee objected that the agenda ran long and it had not seen the new draft agreement. The board then moved to enter executive session on firefighter contract negotiations.

what_happened.line: The board took up earth removal permits with the building commissioner; motions were made to not renew two permits, but the vote results are not audible.
A motion was made to renew one 16-acre permit with a closure plan required for inactive areas, and to extend the 11 Keating permits one year with stipulations; results not audible.
The board held workshops on the artificial turf field agreement, covering how the bond is paid, and on parks, fields and the beach.
The board agreed to keep working on Turkey Hill and central office space, with a list of school office space needs to be provided.
The board agreed to start the December 12th meeting at 6:00 to combine with the economic development workshop, then moved to enter executive session on firefighter contract negotiations.

why_it_matters: The turf field bond is paid from school and Bengals payments plus cell tower revenue, so the agreement terms bear on whether the field costs the town budget, mostly taxes, anything further.
The first year of the municipal employees contract comes from the salary reserve line, and a special town meeting is to fund it, so residents may be asked to vote on that money.
Decisions on Turkey Hill and central offices will determine where town and school staff are housed and what that space costs.
watch_next: The December 12th meeting, starting at 6:00, combined with the economic development workshop.
The special town meeting to fund year one of the municipal employees contract.
